critical_design.note: ERRATUM: V7 predecessor compared manufacturer 33mm ear-span (Z in assembled model) to STEP 32.5mm output-axis (X); the claimed 0.05mm/side interference was INVALID. Correct matched-axis comparisons are manufacturer X30 vs STEP X32.5; Y12 vs STEP Y12.221; Z33 vs STEP Z33.4. Pitch 29mm along Z is authoritative, not necessarily face/horn screw pattern. On 2026-11-23, new outer shell W=105.6mm, true printed door W55mm, and servo retained in 39mm right pier; this does not change the manufacturer's component measurements.
critical_design.servo_lug_mount_status: Onshape nominal screw-boss face is X=shaft_tip+(30-16)+0.30mm. Manufacturer 16.00mm mounting datum, 0.30mm design clearance; ear thickness approx 2.5mm, upper offsets approx 4 and 8mm are NON-driving. Actual screw and horn measurement pending.
